name: Russian Error-Annotated Learner English Corpus
attribution: REALEC Team, Russian Error-Annotated Learner English Corpus; Higher School of Economics, Moscow. The corpus is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International.
purpose: Independent learner-writing evaluation only. Do not train on or tune against the fixed test split.
population: English essays written by Russian L1 university students for examination questions; the full corpus includes multiple cohorts and annotation versions.
annotations: Manually annotated span-level errors from the corpus archive. The source page describes a four-level scheme; span labels identify the local linguistic category.

documentSplit.method: SHA-256 of seed, colon, and source document ID; bucket modulo 100; 70 train, 15 development, 15 test
documentSplit.limitation: Author and prompt identities are unavailable in the archive; document-level separation cannot guarantee writer-level independence. The splits are for evaluation workflow only and do not imply training data is included.
